correctness.rationale: The graph has twelve vertices, 30 listed edges and induced-degree<=1 admissibility. Independently enumerating all 4096 subsets yields exactly 324 augmented faces, f=(12,66,140,105). The explicitly ordered 12-vertex sequential toggling matching gives 152 augmented pairs, leaving 20 critical 3-simplices; independent construction and topological sorting of all 984 directed Hasse incidences confirmed acyclicity. Removing the empty-face pairing gives one critical vertex and twenty 3-cells, hence an integral wedge20 S3 and no torsion. The inspected standalone verifier exhaustively enumerates 120 automorphisms and calculates signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces: A5 proper rotation traces (20,4,-1,0) at orders (1,2,3,5) and antipodal-twisted values (10,2,1,0). A5 rational character identities imply central-even (1+V4+2V5) and odd V5, dimensions 15/5, total20. The integral wedge result is not asserted to split as an integral A5 x C2-module.

value.rationale: The icosahedral graph is a canonical nonchordal highly symmetric finite object; Ind2 allows edges but excludes induced paths of three, so it is not its classical independence complex. Computing its full integral homotopy type and A5 x C2 rational homology character is a meaningful natural exact invariant. The antipodal-odd dimension five adds representation data not implied by the wedge count. No family-sized result is needed to justify an exact high-symmetry test example.
